posts.text: Seattle called. Then Toronto called back 🙈 Excited.. actually ASTOUNDED to announce I'll be interning at Microsoft in SEATTLE for Summer 2027, then IBM in Toronto for Fall 2027. Microsoft was a cold apply with no referral. It’ll also be my first time living and working outside of Canada, which is equal parts exciting and terrifying. Packing up and moving across the continent for a summer is a whole new kind of side quest 🇨🇦 → 🇺🇸 Huge thank you to Debra for opening the door at IBM and keeping it

72 hours with no sleep. 300+ participants. 70+ projects. Sheridan’s biggest datathon ever 🥹 This past weekend, I directed the Sheridan Datathon 2026, and it turned into the biggest datathon Sheridan has ever had, the biggest in GTA, and our biggest GDG event yet. Some students even flew in for it. Teams spent 24 hours digging through real datasets and came out with insights that impressed every judge in the room. 8 months ago, Ember was just a hackathon idea. This month, we sat across the table from VCs, got written up in the news, and had fire captains reach out to us. Honestly.. it's been surreal. We've spent hours talking with investors about what it takes to build hardware for public safety. And we've put the prototype in front of the people it's actually for: firefighters who run into the buildings we're designing around.
